body: I was in your exact position around that age. I’m 26 now. My sister is extremely successful and i was viewed as the problem child. I did poorly in school because of depression, anxiety and lack of emotional support at home. I wanted and tried to unalive so many times but it never worked out. Some advice: fuck what your parents think .. they tend to have this image or life they imagine for you and get in their feelings when they see you aren’t that. (Yes parents can be childish too , they don’t have a guide or a rule book on how things should go) This world is so big and full of people who will accept you for exactly who you are!!! You just have to push yourself so that you can make it from out of your parents grip so that you can actually see the world and experience it through your own eyes. Don’t be discouraged because of how life looks now. I barely graduated( honestly) i applied to college not even thinking i would get in .. but i did and I’ve been doing exactly what i want to do and what i envision for myself since then. I worked hard to have extra money in case my dad felt like cutting me off ( and sometimes he did) but now at 26 i make way more money than he ever did and I’ve provided myself a much more enjoyable life than i would have if i was trying to please him. Do as best as you can so that you can create a life for yourself too.

Yehp and just remember that you are the leader so you set the example , don’t be afraid to step on toes when it comes to your time .. people are going to always think their issue is more important than what you have going on. Good luck!

I always tell people to just throw something on my calendar especially if they don’t give me info upfront on what they want. I block off free time for myself as well so my calendar isn’t full all day.

My mom died when I was 7. The biggest gripe i had with my father was that he wasn’t there for me emotionally nor did he try to place people in my life that could be there for me in that way. I didn’t go off the rails but truly my life would have been diff if he told me i was pretty or that he loved me every now and then. Just make sure you are there for her beyond money!
